markup_own_pct.label: Sub markup on its own work
markup_own_pct.quote: A subcontractor may add overhead and profit of up to 10% on its own direct cost and up to 5% on the cost of work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors.

markup_lower_pct.label: Sub markup on lower-tier work
markup_lower_pct.quote: A subcontractor may add overhead and profit of up to 10% on its own direct cost and up to 5% on the cost of work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors.

markup_total_pct.label: Total sub markup cap
markup_total_pct.quote: Total markup on any portion of the work shall not exceed 15%.

fee_pct.label: CM fee
fee_pct.quote: CM may add a Fee of 5% to the direct costs and subcontractor markups of a change.

fee_allowed_on.label: Fee allowed on
fee_allowed_on.quote: CM may add a Fee of 5% to the direct costs and subcontractor markups of a change.
fee_allowed_on.note: not all categories appear in the sentence

labor_burden_pct.label: Labor burden
labor_burden_pct.quote: Reimbursable Cost of the Work includes subcontract payments, materials, CM labor at the rates in the approved labor schedule plus a fixed labor burden of 32% of direct wages, bond and insurance premiums at actual cost, Washington B&O taxes at actual cost, and permit fees.

blue_book_pct.label: Owned equipment rate
blue_book_pct.quote: Other CM-owned equipment is charged at 75% of the current published Blue Book rental rate, and rented equipment at the invoiced cost with no markup other than the Fee.

approval_limit.label: Owner's rep approval limit
approval_limit.quote: Owner's Representative may approve a CO of up to $250,000.

notice_days_standard.label: Notice window (RFI, directions, site conditions)
notice_days_standard.quote: (a) 7 days after CM receives an RFI response, ASI, or submittal return that CM believes changes cost or time;

notice_days_other.label: Notice window (other events)
notice_days_other.quote: (d) 14 days after CM first knew or should have known of any other event that may increase cost or time.

contract_days.label: Contract time
contract_days.quote: CM shall achieve Substantial Completion within 540 days after the Notice to Proceed, and Final Completion within 60 days after Substantial Completion.

liquidated_damages_per_day.label: Liquidated damages
liquidated_damages_per_day.quote: If CM fails to achieve Substantial Completion on time, CM shall pay Owner $2,500 for each day of delay.

daily_delay_rate.label: Daily rate for extended general conditions
daily_delay_rate.quote: SGC may be increased only by CO for an extension of Contract Time, at a daily rate of $3,185 per day.

sgc_total.label: General conditions total
sgc_total.quote: SGC is $1,720,000, billed as shown in Exhibit C.

extension_requires_critical_path.label: Extension needs the critical path
extension_requires_critical_path.quote: A time extension is compensated only for delays caused by Owner or Architect that are on the critical path, using the SGC daily rate in Section 5.2 and with no Fee.

compensable_causes.label: Delays that earn money
compensable_causes.quote: A time extension is compensated only for delays caused by Owner or Architect that are on the critical path, using the SGC daily rate in Section 5.2 and with no Fee.

concurrent_delay.label: Concurrent delay
concurrent_delay.quote: Delays with concurrent causes receive time but no compensation.

markup_own_pct.label: Sub markup on its own work
markup_own_pct.quote: Self-performed work shall not exceed 25% of the combined cost of subcontracted and self-performed work over the life of the Project.

markup_lower_pct.label: Sub markup on lower-tier work
markup_lower_pct.quote: A Subcontractor may add a combined allowance for overhead and profit of not more than 8% of the cost of the changed work it performs with its own forces, and not more than 4% of the cost of changed work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors.

markup_total_pct.label: Total sub markup cap
markup_total_pct.quote: In no event shall the cumulative markup of all tiers on any portion of the changed work exceed 12%.

fee_pct.label: CM fee
fee_pct.quote: On each Change Order CM may add a Fee of 4.5%, computed only on CM direct costs and subcontractor quotes.

fee_allowed_on.label: Fee allowed on
fee_allowed_on.quote: On each Change Order CM may add a Fee of 4.5%, computed only on CM direct costs and subcontractor quotes.

labor_burden_pct.label: Labor burden
labor_burden_pct.quote: Wages of CM's field labor shall be paid at the rates in the approved labor rate schedule plus a fixed labor burden equal to 30% of direct wages, which covers payroll taxes, workers' compensation, benefits, and union fringes.

blue_book_pct.label: Owned equipment rate
blue_book_pct.quote: Equipment owned by CM or by an entity affiliated with CM shall be charged at 70% of the monthly, weekly, or daily rental rate, whichever is lowest for the duration of use, published in the current edition of the Equipment Watch Rental Rate Blue Book, without separate charges for fuel or maintenance.

approval_limit.label: Owner's rep approval limit
approval_limit.quote: The Owner's Representative may execute any Change Order whose value does not exceed $150,000.

notice_days_standard.label: Notice window (RFI, directions, site conditions)
notice_days_standard.quote: CM shall give written notice of a Potential Change within 10 days after it receives an RFI response, Architect's Supplemental Instruction, submittal return, or written or oral direction from Owner or Architect, or after it first observes a concealed or unknown physical condition, which in that case it shall not disturb before giving notice.

notice_days_other.label: Notice window (other events)
notice_days_other.quote: For any other event that may increase its cost or time, CM shall give notice within 21 days after it knew or reasonably should have known of the event.

contract_days.label: Contract time
contract_days.quote: CM shall achieve Substantial Completion of the entire Work not later than 420 days after the date of commencement, subject to adjustment only by Change Order.

liquidated_damages_per_day.label: Liquidated damages
liquidated_damages_per_day.quote: If CM fails to achieve Substantial Completion within the Contract Time, CM shall pay Owner, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, $1,800 for each day that Substantial Completion is late.

daily_delay_rate.label: Daily rate for extended general conditions
daily_delay_rate.quote: If the Contract Time is extended by Change Order for a delay for which CM is entitled to compensation under Section 7.5.6, the General Conditions Costs shall be increased at the rate of $2,450 for each day of the extension, with no Fee added.

sgc_total.label: General conditions total
sgc_total.quote: The General Conditions Costs are a fixed sum of $1,286,000, covering the project manager, superintendents, project engineers, safety staff, field office, temporary toilets, project vehicles, and small tools.

extension_requires_critical_path.label: Extension needs the critical path
extension_requires_critical_path.quote: The Contract Time may be extended only by Change Order and only for a delay that is beyond the control and without the fault of CM and its Subcontractors, that is shown by a time impact analysis to delay an activity on the critical path of the most recent accepted schedule update, and for which CM has given timely notice under Section 7.2.

compensable_causes.label: Delays that earn money
compensable_causes.quote: CM is entitled to an increase in the General Conditions Costs for an extension of the Contract Time only when the delay was caused by Owner, or by a separate contractor or consultant retained by Owner other than Architect, and the delay affected the critical path.

concurrent_delay.label: Concurrent delay
concurrent_delay.quote: When a delay to the critical path has concurrent causes and one of them is the responsibility of CM or its Subcontractors, CM shall receive an extension of time but no additional compensation for the period of concurrency.
